operations.name: Saw Cut Stock
operations.setup_note: Saw the provisional hot-rolled round-bar blank to the required cut length. Finished length is not stated, so blank length remains to be confirmed.

operations.name: CNC Lathe - Rough OD and Bore, Finish Bore
operations.setup_note: Chuck the cut blank, face the accessible end to establish an axial reference, and machine the OD before boring for rigidity. Rough the OD and bore, then finish the bore before finish-turning the OD because the finished tube wall is relatively thin.

operations.name: CNC Lathe - Finish OD and Chamfer First End
operations.setup_note: Locate on the finished bore with an expanding mandrel to support the thin wall. Finish the OD and machine the accessible end chamfer.

operations.name: CNC Lathe - Reverse and Finish Second End
operations.setup_note: Reverse the part and hold it in soft jaws on the finished OD. Face the remaining end to length and machine its chamfer.

operations.name: Deburr
operations.setup_note: Remove burrs from the machined edges and bore ends, preserving the specified chamfers and finished surfaces.

operations.name: Final Inspection
operations.setup_note: Inspect the OD, through bore, and both end chamfers against the drawing after the part has stabilized.

clarifications.question: What starting stock form is intended for this part: solid round bar or seamless mechanical tube?
clarifications.suggested_default: Proceed provisionally with hot-rolled solid round bar because no tube grade or tube blank is specified.

clarifications.question: What is the finished overall length of the part?

assumptions.text: Because the blank type is unstated and the material callout does not specify a mechanical-tube grade, the provisional stock is hot-rolled round bar sized above the finished OD. This assumes boring the through bore from solid stock; confirm the intended stock form because a tube blank could materially reduce machining.

The drawing view provides no finished length, so stock cut length and final face position cannot be specified. Center drilling is not included; add center support if the confirmed length requires it, including if the length-to-diameter ratio exceeds 4:1.
Grooving and threading are omitted because no groove or thread features are shown. Part-off is omitted because the route starts with saw-cut individual blanks rather than bar-fed production.
